nodes.description: owner address stored in Owned; set to msg.sender at deployment and changed by acceptOwnership.
newOwner address staged by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership.
mapping(address => uint) balances holding token balances of every account.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) allowance table used by transferFrom and approveAndCall.
uint _totalSupply fixed at 100,000,000 * 10^18 in the Visor constructor.
string public symbol set to "XVR" in the constructor.
string public name set to "Visor" in the constructor.
uint8 public decimals set to 18 in the constructor.
SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b) pure; returns a+b and requires c >= a.
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b) pure; requires b <= a then returns a-b.
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b) pure; guards multiplication result.
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b) pure; requires b > 0.
Owned() constructor assigning owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner modifier enforcing require(msg.sender == owner) before guarded functions.
Only-owner function staging newOwner = _newOwner (two-step ownership handover).
Accepts ownership when msg.sender == newOwner, emits OwnershipTransferred and rewrites owner/newOwner.
Visor() constructor initialising symbol/name/decimals/_totalSupply and pre-funding the fixed holder address.
totalSupply() constant returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)].
balanceOf(address tokenOwner) constant returning balances[tokenOwner].
transfer(address to, uint tokens) moves tokens from msg.sender using safeSub/safeAdd and emits Transfer.
approve(address spender, uint tokens) sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] and emits Approval.
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens) debits from-balance and msg.sender allowance, credits to-balance.
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender) constant returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data) approves then calls spender.receiveApproval with msg.sender, tokens, this, data.
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts so no ETH is accepted.
onlyOwner function forwarding an external ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) call.
msg.sender, the caller-controlled address used for ownership, balance and allowance lookups.
safeSub(balances[msg.sender], tokens) arithmetic write in transfer; correctness depends on SafeMath.
safeAdd(balances[to], tokens) arithmetic write in transfer.
safeSub on balances[from] and on allowed[from][msg.sender] inside transferFrom.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) executed after the allowance state write in approveAndCall.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) with an owner-supplied arbitrary contract address.
Ownership state mutation owner = newOwner / newOwner = address(0) in acceptOwnership, guarded only by require(msg.sender == newOwner).

edges.reason: transfer() reads balances[msg.sender], so the caller address flows into the transfer logic.
approve() writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] using the caller address.
transferFrom() subtracts from allowed[from][msg.sender], so the caller is part of the allowance key.
approveAndCall() uses msg.sender both as allowance owner and as the 'from' argument of the external call.
Owned constructor sets owner = msg.sender, establishing the privileged account.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender against owner to gate privileged functions.
acceptOwnership() requires msg.sender == newOwner, a caller-controlled authorization check.
msg.sender is written into the owner state variable at deployment and on ownership transfer.
msg.sender drives the ownership mutation performed by acceptOwnership.
onlyOwner reads the owner state variable for its privilege comparison.
transferOwnership is only reachable through the onlyOwner guard.
transferAnyERC20Token is only reachable through the onlyOwner guard.
